# Step 0 - Data Loading & Preparation

```{r load-data}
# Set working directory and load data setwd(params$base_output_dir)
sequence_main_final <- read_csv(file.path(params$OUTPUT_RES_DIR,"sequence_main_final.csv"))
survival_endpoint <- read.csv(params$OUTCOME_FILE_PATH)

node_topology_summary <- read.csv(file.path(params$OUTPUT_RES_DIR,"Node_Community_detection_centrality.csv"))
# Community label mapping
if(params$MAPPING_COM_PATH != ""){
  community_labels <- read.csv(params$MAPPING_COM_PATH)
node_topology_summary <- left_join(node_topology_summary,community_labels, join_by("Community"=="community_number"))
} else{
  node_topology_summary$community_name <- paste0("COM_",node_topology_summary$Community)
}
n_com <- length(unique(node_topology_summary$community_name))
node_topology_summary %>%
  select(Node, Community, community_name) %>%
  arrange(Community) %>%
  kable(caption = "Disease-to-community assignment") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

# Step 1 - Community Transition Matrix

```{r transition-matrix}
# 1.1: Ordered sequence with community labels
seq_comm_clean <- sequence_main_final %>%
  left_join(node_topology_summary, join_by("event_name"=="Node")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(community_name)) %>%
  arrange(ID, age_in_days_since_born)

seq_ordered <- seq_comm_clean %>%
  select(ID, age_in_days_since_born, community_name)

comm_levels <- levels(as.factor(node_topology_summary$community_name))

# 1.2: Consecutive (from, to) pairs
transitions <- seq_ordered %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(from = community_name, to = lead(community_name)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(to)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 1.3: Count per patient
trans_counts <- transitions %>%
  mutate(
    from = factor(from, levels = comm_levels),
    to   = factor(to,   levels = comm_levels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID, from, to, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# 1.4: Pivot to n^2-dim vector (nxn matrix flattened)
trans_wide <- trans_counts %>%
  mutate(trans_name = paste0("T_", as.integer(from), "_", as.integer(to))) %>%
  select(ID, trans_name, n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = trans_name, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

all_trans <- paste0("T_", rep(1:n_com, each = n_com), "_", rep(1:n_com, times = n_com))
for (col in setdiff(all_trans, colnames(trans_wide))) trans_wide[[col]] <- 0
trans_wide <- trans_wide %>% select(ID, all_of(all_trans))

# 1.5: Row-normalise
trans_mat      <- as.matrix(trans_wide[, -1])
row_sums       <- rowSums(trans_mat)
trans_mat_norm <- trans_mat / ifelse(row_sums == 0, 1, row_sums)

# Average transition matrix (all patients)
avg_trans_df <- data.frame(
  from = factor(rep(comm_levels, each  = n_com), levels = comm_levels),
  to   = factor(rep(comm_levels, times = n_com), levels = comm_levels),
  prob = colMeans(trans_mat_norm)
)

p <- ggplot(avg_trans_df, aes(x = to, y = from, fill = prob)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", prob)), size = 3.8) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1,
                        name = "Normalized \ntransition mean") +
  labs(title = "Average community transition matrix (all patients)",
       subtitle = "Row = origin community, Column = destination community",
       x = "To", y = "From") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(params$OUTPUT_PLOT_DIR, "Average_community_transition_matrix.svg"),
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 10
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(params$OUTPUT_PLOT_DIR, "Average_community_transition_matrix.png"),
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 400
)

p

```

# Step 2 - Transition based patient clustering

## 2.1 Elbow for transition-matrix clustering

```{r transition-elbow}
set.seed(42)
wss_trans <- sapply(1:8, function(k) {
  kmeans(trans_mat_norm, centers = k, nstart = 10, iter.max = 100)$tot.withinss
})

data.frame(k = 1:8, wss = wss_trans) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = k, y = wss)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:8) +
  labs(title = "Elbow – transition matrix clustering",
       x = "k", y = "Total within-cluster SS") +
  theme_bw()
```

*USER-INPUT NECESSARY: looking at the wlbow plot select k_chosen*

```{r user-defined k}
k_chosen=4
```

## 2.2 K-means on transition matrices

```{r transition-kmeans}
set.seed(42)
km_trans <- kmeans(trans_mat_norm, centers = k_chosen,
                   nstart = 50, iter.max = 200)

trans_wide[, all_trans] <- trans_mat_norm

trans_wide <- trans_wide %>%
  mutate(cluster_trans = factor(km_trans$cluster,
                                 labels = paste0("Cluster ", seq_len(k_chosen))))

# Mean transition matrix per cluster
 p <- trans_wide %>%
  group_by(cluster_trans) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(all_trans), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-cluster_trans, names_to = "transition", values_to = "mean_prob") %>%
  tidyr::separate(transition, into = c("drop", "from_idx", "to_idx"),
                  sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  mutate(
    from = factor(comm_levels[as.integer(from_idx)], levels = comm_levels),
    to   = factor(comm_levels[as.integer(to_idx)],   levels = comm_levels)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = to, y = from, fill = mean_prob)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", mean_prob)), size = 2.8) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1, name = "Normalized \ntransition mean") +
  facet_wrap(~ cluster_trans) +
  labs(title = "Average community transition matrix (by cluster)", x = "To", y = "From") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))
 
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(params$OUTPUT_PLOT_DIR, "Average_community_transition_matrix_by_cluster.svg"),
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 10
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(params$OUTPUT_PLOT_DIR, "Average_community_transition_matrix_by_cluster.png"),
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 400
)

p

```


# Step 3 - Kaplan–Meier survival by transition cluster

```{r transition-survival}
surv_df_trans <- survival_endpoint %>%
  inner_join(trans_wide %>% select(ID,cluster_trans), by="ID")

km_fit_trans <- survfit(
  Surv(event_time / 365.25, event_status) ~ cluster_trans,
  data = surv_df_trans
)

x_lim = c(round(min(surv_df_trans$event_time)/365.25)-10, round(max(surv_df_trans$event_time)/365.25)+10)

p <- ggsurvplot(km_fit_trans,
           data        = surv_df_trans,
           pval        = TRUE,
           conf.int    = TRUE,
           risk.table  = TRUE,
           palette     = "Pastel2",
           xlab        = "Age (years)",
           ylab        = "Survival probability",
           title       = "Kaplan–Meier survival by transition matrix cluster",
           legend.labs = levels(surv_df_trans$cluster_trans),
           ylim        = c(0, 1),
           xlim        = c(x_lim[1],x_lim[2]))

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(params$OUTPUT_PLOT_DIR, "Survival_by_cluster.png"),
  plot = print(p),
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 400
)
```

# Step 4 - Descriptive statistics per cluster

```{r trans-cluster-descriptive}
distinct_per_comm <- seq_comm_clean %>%
  group_by(ID, community_name) %>%
  summarise(n_distinct = n_distinct(event_name), .groups = "drop")

first_comm <- seq_comm_clean %>%
  arrange(ID, age_in_days_since_born) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(ID, first_community = community_name)
 
profile_wide <- distinct_per_comm %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from  = community_name,
              values_from = n_distinct,
              values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(total_distinct=rowSums(select(., -ID), na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(
  across(-c(ID, total_distinct), ~ (.x/total_distinct),.names="{.col}_prop")
    )

total_events <- seq_comm_clean %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(total_events = n(), .groups = "drop")

profile_wide <- profile_wide %>%
  left_join(total_events, by = "ID") %>%
  inner_join(survival_endpoint, by="ID") %>%
  inner_join(trans_wide %>% select(ID,cluster_trans), by="ID") %>%
  left_join(first_comm, by = "ID") 

entropy_fn <- function(b) { b <- b[b > 0]; -sum(b * log(b)) }
 
profile_wide <- profile_wide %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(entropy=entropy_fn(c_across(ends_with("_prop")))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(entropy_norm = entropy / log(4))   # log(4) ≈ 1.386

trans_cluster_desc <- profile_wide %>%
  group_by(cluster_trans) %>%
  summarise(
    N                  = n(),
    pct_dead           = round(100 * mean(event_status), 1),
    age_death_yrs_mean = round(mean(event_time[event_status == 1] / 365.25, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    age_death_yrs_sd   = round(sd(event_time[event_status == 1] / 365.25, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
 
    mean_distinct      = round(mean(total_distinct), 2),
    sd_distinct        = round(sd(total_distinct), 2),
    mean_total_events  = round(mean(total_events), 2),
    sd_total_events    = round(sd(total_events), 2),
    mean_entropy_norm  = round(mean(entropy_norm), 3),
    sd_entropy_norm    = round(sd(entropy_norm), 3),
 
    across(
      ends_with("_prop"),
      ~ round(mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      .names = "mean_{.col}"
    ),
    
    across(
    ends_with("_prop"),
    ~round(100*mean(.x==1, na.rm=TRUE), 1),
    .names="pct_{.col}_only"
    ),
 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

trans_cluster_desc %>%
  kable(caption = "Descriptive statistics per transition cluster") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

## 4.1 Boxplots: entropy, distinct diseases, total events

```{r trans-cluster-boxplots}
pt1 <- ggplot(profile_wide,
              aes(x = cluster_trans, y = entropy_norm, fill = cluster_trans)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(title = "Normalised entropy", x = NULL, y = "Entropy") +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none")

pt2 <- ggplot(profile_wide,
              aes(x = cluster_trans, y = total_distinct, fill = cluster_trans)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(title = "Distinct diseases", x = NULL, y = "N") +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none")

pt3 <- ggplot(profile_wide,
              aes(x = cluster_trans, y = total_events, fill = cluster_trans)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(title = "Total events", x = NULL, y = "N") +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none")

pt1 | pt2 | pt3
```

## 2.2. Mortality rate per transition cluster

```{r trans-cluster-mortality-bar}
ggplot(trans_cluster_desc,
       aes(x = cluster_trans, y = pct_dead, fill = cluster_trans)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.8, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct_dead, "%")), vjust = -0.4, size = 4.5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(title = "Mortality rate per transition cluster",
       x = NULL, y = "% deceased") +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## 2.3 First community entered per transition cluster

```{r trans-cluster-first-community}
profile_wide %>%
  count(cluster_trans, first_community) %>%
  group_by(cluster_trans) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  kable(caption = "First community entered, by transition cluster") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

## 2.4 Mean community profile per transition cluster

```{r trans-cluster-profile-heatmap}
profile_wide %>%
  group_by(cluster_trans) %>%
  summarise(
    across(ends_with("_prop"), mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -cluster_trans,
    names_to  = "community",
    values_to = "mean_prop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    community = gsub("_prop$", "", community)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = community, y = cluster_trans, fill = mean_prop)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", mean_prop)), size = 4.5) +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "Greens",
    direction = 1,
    name = "Mean\nproportion"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean community profile per transition cluster",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1)
  )
```
